description_en: Queries the list of message ACK records by message ID or device ID
description_zh: 根据消息id、设备id查询消息ack记录列表
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc list-message-acks --page-size 20 --project-id gsgshhfs --device-id fc71429ddd9b473c81d7ef5f33ab10cc --message-id 24266 --page-index 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMessageAcks

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The ID of the IoVCC project.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the IoVCC project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description_en:
The device ID in the DIS system. The query results vary based on the parameters:

1. If only DeviceId is specified as a conditional query, the message ACK records of the specified device are returned.
2. If both DeviceId and MessageId are specified, the ACK record of the specified message on the specified device is returned.
parameters.description_zh:
dis系统设备ID。可实现查询结果：

1. 单独DeviceId条件查询时，返回该设备消息ack记录列表。
2. 与MessageId参数联合查询时，返回指定设备指定消息ack记录。
